name: Neuroscience Graduate Program (PhD)
detailsNote: The program page gives the application window as closing 12/7/26 for Summer 2027 and says the deadline is in early December each year. Fall 2027 entry is not stated, so these are shown as published dates.
summary: Neuroscience PhD at the University of Cincinnati College of Medicine. First-year students typically do two to four research rotations before choosing a lab.

publishedDeadlines.label: Application window closes (labelled Summer 2027)
publishedDeadlines.note: The program page says "The Summer 2027 application window is open now and will close on 12/7/26." No time of day. Fall 2027 is not named.

publishedDeadlines.label: Usual deadline (no year)
publishedDeadlines.note: The How to Apply page says the deadline to receive a completed application is in early December each year, without a date or year.

timeline.interviews: Applicant interviews will be held from late January to mid-February.

english.note: Applicants from universities whose primary language is not English must arrange for TOEFL/IELTS scores to be sent directly to UC. No minimum scores are stated on the pages read.

applicationFee.note: The page says $65 for US applicants and $70 for international applicants. It does not mention fee waivers.

documents: Personal statement on scientific interests and prior research experience

funding.note: The page says competitive stipends, tuition scholarships and health insurance are provided to all admitted students. The financial page gives a $35,000 stipend rising to $36,050 on July 1, 2025, so the current amount should be confirmed. Some fellowships are for US citizens and permanent residents.
